description: This Python source file defines a class `BedrockFilesHandler` that manages handling and downloading files from Amazon S3 for Bedrock batch processing within an AWS environment. It includes methods for extracting S3 URIs from file IDs, parsing S3 URIs, and synchronous/asynchronous methods for downloading file contents using credentials obtained via boto3. It leverages external libraries such as httpx and boto3, and references internal modules for specific types and HTTP handling.
